description: Labeled Datasets for Air Handling Units Operating in Faulted and Fault-free States is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Naghmeh Ghalamsiah et al. Data-driven fault detection and diagnosis (FDD) for buildings’ heating, ventilating, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems has gained popularity in recent years. However, the scarcity of well-labeled data that represents true fault symptoms presents a challenge for developing new FDD methods. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. Formats: CSV, PDF. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 928675992 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
